integrity.claim_scope: weighted complete affine plane-sum views for the two rulings on determinant-zero 2x2 matrices, complex signals, any finite field
critical_evidence: nondegenerate determinant polar pairing even in characteristic two

scientific_limitations: All prime powers are proved analytically, but finite-field incidence calculations were executed only for q=2,3,4. Arbitrary erasures of individual affine cosets, and recovery of invertible-frequency components, are not covered. Historical priority may depend on inaccessible broader finite-Radon references.
title: Regulus-rigid tight affine tomography on the finite-field determinant cone
